{{nihongo|'''Wanishita Shrine'''|和爾下神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Wanishita Shrine'''（わにしたじんじゃ）is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Yokota-chō, {{ill|Yamatokōriyama|ar|ياماتوكورياما (نارا)|azb|یاماتوکوری‌یاما، نارا|bg|Яматокорияма|ca|Yamato-Kōriyama|ce|Яматокорияма|ceb|Yamatokōriyama-shi|cs|Jamatokórijama|de|Yamatokōriyama|eo|Yamatokōriyama|es|Yamatokōriyama (Nara)|fa|یاماتوکوری‌یاما، نارا|fi|Yamato-Kōriyama|fr|Yamatokōriyama|gl|Yamatokōriyama|hy|Յամատոկորիյամա|id|Yamatokōriyama, Nara|it|Yamatokōriyama|ja|大和郡山市|ko|야마토코리야마시|mzn|یاماتوکوری‌یاما، نارا|nl|Yamatokoriyama|pl|Yamato-Kōriyama|pt|Yamatokoriyama|ro|Yamatokōriyama|ru|Яматокорияма|simple|Yamatokōriyama|sv|Yamatokōriyama|tg|Яматокорияма|th|ยามาโตโกริยามะ|tl|Yamatokōriyama|tr|Yamatokōriyama|tt|Яматокорияма|tum|Yamatokōriyama|uk|Ямато-Коріяма|ur|یاماتوکوریما، نارا|vi|Yamatokōriyama, Nara|war|Yamatokōriyama, Nara|zh|大和郡山市|zh_classical|大和郡山市|zh_min_nan|Yamatokôriyama-chhī|zh_yue|大和郡山|qid=Q118213}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. It is a {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinai small shrine}}; under the former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} system it was a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}, and it was also a {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=shrine receiving offerings}}{{sfn|奈良県史|p=54}}.

=== History ===
It is located on the south bank about 1.5 {{ill|Kilometre|af|Kilometer|an|Kilometro|ar|كيلومتر|ary|كيلوميتر|arz|كيلومتر|ast|Quilómetru|az|Kilometr|azb|کیلومتر|ban|Kilométer|bcl|Kilometro|be|Кіламетр|be_x_old|Кілямэтар|bg|Километър|bn|কিলোমিটার|bo|སྤྱི་ལེ།|bs|Kilometar|ca|Quilòmetre|cdo|Gŭng-lī|ckb|کیلۆمەتر|cs|Kilometr|cu|Хїлїомєтро|cv|Километр|cy|Cilometr|da|Kilometer|de|Kilometer|dv|ކިލޯމީޓަރު|el|Χιλιόμετρο|eml|Kilòmeter|eo|Kilometro|es|Kilómetro|et|Kilomeeter|eu|Kilometro|ext|Quilómetru|fa|کیلومتر|fi|Kilometri|fr|Kilomètre|fy|Kilometer|ga|Ciliméadar|gl|Quilómetro|gn|Kilómetro|hak|Kûng-lî|he|קילומטר|hi|सहस्रमान|hif|Kilometre|hr|Kilometar|hu|Kilométer|hy|Կիլոմետր|ia|Kilometro|id|Kilometer|io|Kilometro|is|Kílómetri|it|Chilometro|ja|キロメートル|jam|Kilamita|jv|Kilomèter|ka|კილომეტრი|kge|Kilometer (km)|kk|Километр|ko|킬로미터|ksh|Killomeeter|ku|Kîlometre|la|Chiliometrum|lb|Kilometer|li|Kilometer|lmo|Qilometer|lv|Kilometrs|mg|Kilômetatra|mhr|Километр|mk|Километар|ml|കിലോമീറ്റർ|mn|Километр|mr|किलोमीटर|mrj|Уштыш|ms|Kilometer|my|ကီလိုမီတာ|myv|Вайгельпе|ne|किलोमिटर|nl|Kilometer|nn|Kilometer|no|Kilometer|oc|Quilomètre|os|Километр|pa|ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ|pap|Kilometer|pl|Kilometr|pnb|کلومیٹر|ps|کیلومتر|pt|Quilômetro|ro|Kilometru|ru|Километр|sc|Chilòmetru|scn|Chilòmitru|sco|Kilometre|sh|Kilometar|simple|Kilometre|sk|Kilometer|sl|Kilometer|sn|Kiromita|so|Kiilomitir|sq|Kilometri|sr|Километар|sv|Kilometer|sw|Kilomita|szl|Kilomyjter|ta|கிலோமீட்டர்|te|కిలోమీటరు|tg|Километр|th|กิโลเมตร|tl|Kilometro|tr|Kilometre|tt|Километр|udm|Километр|uk|Кілометр|ur|کلو میٹر|uz|Kilometr|vec|Chiłòmetro|vi|Kilômét|wa|Kilomete|war|Kilometro|wuu|千米|xmf|კილომეტრი|yi|קילאמעטער|zh|公里|zh_classical|公里|zh_min_nan|Kong-lí|zh_yue|千米|qid=Q828224}} from the confluence of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Takase River (Nara)}} and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Wani River}}, facing the old {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Tatsuta Road}}{{sfn|奈良県史|p=329}}{{sfn|寺院神社大事典|p=832}}. In contrast to {{ill|Wanishita Shrine (Ichinomoto)|Q59282589|qid=Q59282589|lt=Wanishita Shrine}} in {{ill|Tenri, Nara|Q502196|qid=Q502196}}, about 2.5 km east, this shrine is also called Shimoharumichi-no-miya (or Shimojidō-gu) and Shimoharumichi Tennō{{sfn|寺院神社大事典|p=832}}. It is regarded as one of the two seats of '''Wajirimo Shrine''' listed in {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} under {{ill|Soekami District, Nara|Q7553491|qid=Q7553491}}{{sfn|寺院神社大事典|p=832}}.

The area around the shrine is believed to have been the base of the Sakurai clan, a branch of the {{ill|Wani clan|Q11417873|qid=Q11417873}}, and artifacts dating to the {{ill|Yayoi period|Q207858|qid=Q207858}} have been excavated from Yokota Shimoike north of the shrine. It is thought this shrine originally enshrined the ancestral deity of the Sakurai clan, and that its source deity may have been the Wani clan ancestor {{ill|Prince Ametarashihiko|ja|天足彦国押人命|qid=Q11443593}}{{sfn|奈良県史|p=329}}. It is said the ujiko extended as far south as {{ill|Yamashiro Province|Q749276|qid=Q749276}}'s {{ill|Hōsono|Q30937308|qid=Q30937308}}{{sfn|奈良県史|p=329}}.

=== Precincts ===
[[File:Wanishita Shrine (Yokota) Keidai.jpg|thumb|200px|Precincts]]
=== Honden ===
A two-bay {{ill|Nagare-zukuri|Q210684|qid=Q210684}} structure with copper-plate roofing{{sfn|奈良県史|p=304}}. Records state that the former shrine building of Mizutani Shrine, a subsidiary shrine of {{ill|Kasuga-taisha|Q714559|qid=Q714559}}, was transferred here in Kan'ei 10 ({{ill|1633|Q6870|qid=Q6870}}){{sfn|奈良県史 建築|p=911}}.
